thread:
violet: heads-up — ran the macOS pkg installer on Monterey (corporate laptop). redwoodctl localserve starts but login never opens my browser and CLI reports "failed to create config dir: permission denied". binary is at /private/var/folders/.../AppTranslocation/.../redwoodctl. anyone seen app translocation + installer weirdness?

harold: yep. if Gatekeeper quarantine isn't cleared pkg installs can be translocated which changes the executable path and can make XDG dirs resolve weirdly. check `xattr -l /path/to/redwoodctl` and `spctl --status`. Also `ps aux | grep redwoodctl` to see exec path.

violet: `xattr` shows com.apple.quarantine present. `ps` shows exec path under /private/var/... AppTranslocation. When I try `open https://login.redwood.local/device` from terminal it does nothing. Also `ls -ld ~/.config/redwood` shows it doesn't exist and `mkdir` fails with permission denied even though my user owns home dir.

devex-bot: Known class: DX-5305 "macOS installer + Gatekeeper/App Translocation causing weird exec paths and permission failures". Workaround: run `sudo xattr -r -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Redwood\ App` (or the binary path) and move the binary to /usr/local/bin, or use the brew/tar distribution. Also ensure installer creates config dir at install time with correct ownership.

harold: also check if the package ran as root but wrote config scaffolding to a directory owned by root inside the user home (some installers incorrectly expand ~ to root when run in a different context). `ls -la ~ | grep redwood` and `stat -f "%Su %Sp" ~/.config` will help.

violet: `ls -la ~` shows a folder `Redwood` owned by root (created during install). I chowned it and removed the quarantine attribute, moved binary to /usr/local/bin, and re-ran `redwoodctl login` — browser opened and device flow completed. localserve now serves my sample app.

sam: follow-ups: installer should not create user-scoped dirs as root; postinstall should create ~/.config/redwood with correct ownership when run in user context. Also surface a clearer error when com.apple.quarantine detected: "binary quarantined; run xattr -d or use brew". filing DX-5305 for installer + docs.

marta: small DX improvement: onboarding doc should include macOS checklist: 1) gatekeeper xattr note, 2) ensure /usr/local/bin on PATH or prefer brew, 3) permission checks for ~/.config/redwood, 4) sample-app env var REDWOODCTL_RUN_DIR for nonstandard installs. I'll add it to DOCS-1502.

violet: thanks — attaching the installer log to DX-5305. saved me an hour. :coffee:
